traits.name: Loner
traits.desc: Prefers private quarters; moody in shared housing.

traits.name: Sociable
traits.desc: Thrives in shared housing; uncomfortable alone.

traits.name: Disciplined
traits.desc: Suited to barracks life; finds private quarters wasteful.

traits.name: Corrupt
traits.desc: Skims what passes through their hands.

traits.name: Charismatic
traits.desc: A room warms when they walk in.

traits.name: Reclusive
traits.desc: Keeps to themselves; the town knows them by reputation, not face.

traits.name: Disgraced
traits.desc: A scandal clings to their name; redemption is possible, but earned.
